blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—A commotion marked the conclusion of University of the Philippines’ 82-74 win over Ateneo in the second round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. With the game already decided, Fighting Maroons forward Jacob Bayla saw an opportunity to dunk the ball at the buzzer. When he did, Blue Eagles coach Louie Alas was the first to call him out on it. Tempers flared during the post-game handshakes, with Alas needing to be separated. Alas, however, was quick to apologize for his actions after […]...
